　舌を噛み切りたくなるほどのおぞましい感触だった。

A hard, bloodless blade,
merging with soft, pulsing flesh.
For a human being, there can surely be no more powerful sensation.
It was so hideous I wanted to bite through my tongue.
Whether it was positive or negative is beside the point.

The pleasure of hacking it apart destroyed me. That day, it was not Arcueid who was killed. It must have been my mind.

　自分でも意識しないまま、俺はナイフをポケットに収めていたらしい。
　たぶん、きっと。
　いつでも人を殺せるように。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah.”
…I couldn’t believe it.
Without even realizing it, I must have slipped the knife into my pocket.
Probably—surely.
So I would always be ready to kill someone.

lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“Haa……ah.”
The moment I reached the schoolyard, my knees gave way.
I knelt in the dirt and caught my collapsing body on both hands.

lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“……”
My body was burning.
But the sensation that I was becoming someone else had vanished.
It must be because—
I violated Kohaku,
and the urge subsided for a little while.

lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――Ghh.”
Stomach acid surged up my throat.
Bitterness flooded my mouth.
I hadn’t eaten all day, so there was nothing to vomit but sour stomach acid.
“Kohaku―――”
An apology could never earn forgiveness for what I had done.
That was why I could not apologize.
How could I ever make amends to her?

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Gg."

"Kohaku---san."

So, I can't apologize.
How can I offer my atonement to her from now on?

もう、何日も前の話。
　アルクェイドを殺してしまって自暴自棄になっていた俺を、シエル先輩が助けてくれた。
　あの人は―――罪を犯す人と犯さない人がいるんじゃなくて、償える人と償えない人がいるだけだ、と教えてくれた。
　でも、どうすれば。
　犯した罪、傷つけた心というのは、償えるっていうんだろう――――
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
That was days ago now.
After I killed Arcueid and fell into despair, Ciel saved me.
She taught me that the world was not divided into those who sinned and those who did not―――only into those who could atone and those who could not.
But how?
How could anyone atone for a crime committed, for a heart wounded――――?

lines.mirrorMoon:
That conversation so many days ago.
When Ciel-senpai helped me while I was in the depths of despair after I killed Arcueid.
That person---she told me that there weren't people who sinned and people who did not sin, but there are only people who can and who cannot atone for their sins.
But, what should I do?
My committed sin, the wounded mind, can it be atoned for----

「―――？」
　すう、とあたりが暗くなった。
　かっ、かっ、という足音。
　地面に手足をついていて下を見ていたから気付かなかったけど、誰かがこっちにやってくる。
　月明かりの下。
　その人の影が、四つんばいになっている俺にかかって暗くなったのか。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――?”
The moonlight dimmed around me.
Clack. Clack. Footsteps.
I had been on all fours, staring at the ground, and hadn’t noticed anyone approaching.
Beneath the moon,
someone’s shadow had fallen over me where I knelt on all fours. Was that why it had grown dark?

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---?"
It suddenly gets darker.
The sound of footsteps.
I didn't realize it since I was face down, but someone is coming.
Under the moonlight.

「懺悔の真似事ですか、遠野くん」
　どこか冷たい、シエル先輩の声。
「――――先輩」
　……本当に、来てくれた。
　ただ先輩の顔を見たくて、夜空をあおぐみたいに顔をあげる。
「――――え？」
―――それは。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“Playing at confession, Tohno?”
Ciel’s voice carried an unfamiliar chill.
“――――Ciel.”
…She had really come.
Wanting only to see her face, I raised my head as though looking up at the night sky.
“――――What?”
―――But what I saw…

A black cross tattooed on her bare arm.
Eyes as cold as if she were looking at a total stranger.
…And a crude, bare weapon whose mere appearance sent a chill through me—something grotesquely ill-suited to her.

「先―――輩？」

“Ci―――el?”
“So you really were Roa, Tohno.”
With the same cold eyes,
she spoke in the same cold voice.

いや、本能と理性が総動員して危険を報せてきて、思わず先輩から跳び退いた。

“――――”
A shudder ran down my spine.
For no reason—no, because instinct and reason were screaming danger with one voice—I sprang away from her.
“――――――”
Her lips pressed into a hard line, Ciel advanced one step with that sinister weapon in her hands.
…Her stance offered no opening at all.

"----"

If I turned my back and fled, that weapon would pierce my heart and erase me beyond all hope of reincarnation; somehow, I knew it.
…Even though no such knowledge existed anywhere in my memories.

My nerves sensed that death was moments away and began to buckle.
My spinal cord shrieked with electric pain; the back of my neck seized tighter and tighter.
But more than the fear of death―――
I simply could not believe she was saying these things to me.

lines.japanese:
「……前に教えてあげたでしょう、遠野くん。
ロアが転生先に選ぶ家系には条件があると。
　逆に言えば、その条件さえあっている家系を探せばいいだけ。
ロアの転生体の特定は、わかってしまえば容易なんですよ。
　その家系が旧い異能の血を継いでいるかは調べればすぐにわかります。
この街ではロアの転生先になるような家柄は一つしかなかった。
　ですから―――初めから誰がロアであるかは解っていたんですよ、わたし」
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“—I explained this before, Tohno. Roa chooses his reincarnation host according to certain conditions.
That means one need only find a family that satisfies them. Once those conditions are known, identifying his reincarnation vessel is easy.
Whether a family carries an ancient supernatural gift can be discovered with very little investigation. In this city, only one lineage qualified as a possible host for Roa.
So―――I knew who Roa was from the very beginning.”

It's easy to find families that have special abilities passed down through their blood once you do a bit of research.
In this city, there is only one family that fits Roa's requirements.
So---I knew from the beginning who Roa was."

Eight years ago, there was a girl who knew as little as you do now.
The urge began corrupting her when she was sixteen.
…Until then, she had known nothing at all. She had none of your unusual powers, Tohno. She had simply lived an ordinary life, never suspecting a thing.”

a scene I had never seen—and somehow remembered—rose inside my head.
Ciel’s story felt terribly similar to the dream I had.

…But through some twist of fate, the girl’s body was exceptionally unusual. It possessed powers of resurrection far beyond those of an ordinary human.
Three years later, though she would have been better off leaving well enough alone, she awoke from death.
…Absurd, isn’t it? An empty shell abandoned by the soul called Roa, and yet it came back to life.”

Even though it was just a discarded shell of Roa's soul, it still came back to life.

　埋葬機関の司祭殿は利用価値があるといって、その子を教会に迎え入れてくれました。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ordinarily, a monster like that would remain imprisoned forever. But the girl had inherited the knowledge of magecraft she possessed while she was Roa.
The priest of the Burial Agency judged her useful and welcomed her into the Church.”
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

lines.japanese:
「それから五年。
生き残ってしまった脱け殻はかつての名前を捨てて、吸血鬼を退治するための生き方を選んだんです。
―――わたしはロアの主であるアルクェイドよりも、ロアという魂が何処に居るかを知覚することができます。
　その理由は、もう言うまでもないでしょう？」
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“Five years have passed since then. The shell that survived abandoned its old name and chose a life devoted to hunting vampires.
―――I can sense where the soul called Roa resides more clearly than Arcueid, Roa’s master.
By now, I hardly need explain why.”

“I told you before, didn’t I, Tohno? Ciel has only one purpose.”
――Because I want to die as a human being――
Back then, I had not understood what those words meant.
But now—
now, perhaps I understood a little.

　ああ、悔しいぐらい、できっこない。

　けど、先輩はそれだけが望みなんだ。
　そうなってしまった思考。
　そんなことしか望めなくなるような人生。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――No. I don’t understand.”
Damn it, I couldn’t possibly understand.
I did not know what it meant to want death. As long as you are alive, you may feel that way sometimes―――but I had never wished for it from the bottom of my heart.
Yet that was Ciel’s only wish.
A mind reduced to that one desire.
A life that had left her capable of wishing for nothing else.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"----I can't."
It's almost regretful, but I can't.
I can't understand that feeling of wanting to die.
As long as I'm alive---I'll think about wanting to die, but I would never truly mean it.
But, that's all Senpai wishes for.
A way of thinking which was transformed into that.
A life that makes you wish only that.

lines.japanese:
俺はまだ知らない。
　自分の手で。
　自分の意思が残ったままで、大切な人たちを殺してしまう痛みを、知らない。
　……そんなもの、一生涯知りたくはない。
　でもこの人はその上にいる。
　だから―――ただ、死にたいと思うのか。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
I still do not know.
I have never known the pain of killing the people I love
with my own hands while my own will remains awake inside me.
…I never want to know it, not for as long as I live.
But she has already passed beyond that pain.
Is that why―――she wishes only to die?

lines.mirrorMoon:

…… And I don't ever want to know it.
But this person has lived through it.
So---is that why she just wants to die?

lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:

lines.mao_english:

lines.japanese:
「………………だ」
　……俺は、頷くしかない。
　彼女の望みも。
　彼女が得てしまった苦しみも、わかってしまった。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“…………You’re right.”
…I could only nod.
I understood both her wish
and the suffering she had been forced to bear.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

and her pain, I understand.

lines.japanese:
「…………いや、だ」
　なにもかも、俺の境遇もシエルの望みもイヤだ。
　こんなもの―――現実だなんて思いたくない。
　けど、現実は待ってくれない。
　ガチャリと音をたてて。
　シエルという代行者が、俺を殺すために踏み込んできた。

もう、これ以上語る言葉もなければ、語る必要もないと。
　シエルの両腕が、あの『凶器』を持ち上げた。

第七聖典。
　輪廻転生を否定する教会が作り上げた、転生批判のあらゆる弾劾を記した教本。
　聖典でありながら外典、教本でありながら凶器という曰くつきの一品だ。
　アレに撃たれれば、魂そのものが霧散する。
lines.label: s297
lines.maoEnglish:
“…………I don’t want this.”
I hated all of it—my own fate, and Ciel’s wish. I did not want to believe any of this―――was real.
But reality did not wait.
With a metallic clack,
Ciel the Executor stepped forward to kill me.
There was nothing left to say and no reason to say it.
Ciel raised the weapon in both hands.
The Seventh Holy Scripture.
A catechism created by the Church that denies reincarnation, inscribed with every indictment ever leveled against the cycle of rebirth.
Holy scripture yet apocryphon, textbook yet weapon—a singular object with a sinister history.
If I were shot with it, my soul itself would scatter into mist.
lines.mao_english:
“…………I don’t want this.”
I hated all of it—my own fate, and Ciel’s wish. I did not want to believe any of this―――was real.
But reality did not wait.

Ciel the Executor stepped forward to kill me.
There was nothing left to say and no reason to say it.
Ciel raised the weapon in both hands.
The Seventh Holy Scripture.
A catechism created by the Church that denies reincarnation, inscribed with every indictment ever leveled against the cycle of rebirth.
Holy scripture yet apocryphon, textbook yet weapon—a singular object with a sinister history.
If I were shot with it, my soul itself would scatter into mist.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"………… I don't want it."
I don't like my treatment or Ciel's wish.
I don't want to think this is reality.
But, time waits for no one.
With a metallic rattle,
the agent called Ciel steps forward to kill me.

As if saying there's no need to talk anymore,
Ciel's hands lift up that weapon.

The Seventh Holy Scripture.
The weapon that the reincarnation-denying Church created.
A scriptural canon inscribed with every possible impeachment of reincarnation criticism.
It's an item that is scripture yet an apocrypha.
A weapon, yet a scripture at the same time.
If I'm hit by that, my soul itself will disperse into nothingness.

My body is terrifyingly light.
It flies forward as if cutting through the wind.
Even with Ciel’s superhuman athleticism, she can never catch me at this speed――――

Perhaps it was exhaustion.
Everything I could see looked hollow, blurred beneath a veil of mist.

Did that mean uncertain?
As uncertain as I was. As uncertain as the human being called Shiki Tohno.

Everything was indistinct and absurd.
A world where death could be seen.
Eyes that saw death.
That day eight years ago.
I met the woman who taught me how to live, and because of her I had managed a normal life.
Even now, I could say without doubt that meeting her had been right.

Before my eyes.

「――――愚か、な」

lines.maoEnglish:

You knew?
“――――You… fool.”
Did you know from the start―――that if either of us bore any guilt, it belonged to you alone?

血液の供給が途絶えて、あと数秒と保つまい。

lines.label: s301
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hah――――ah.”
Feeling drains from my limbs.
My consciousness follows.
With the blood supply cut off, it cannot last more than a few seconds.
At the instant her bayonet struck me, I saw something within myself like an ancient book, scattering its pages as it vanished.
Perhaps. That was the thing called Roa dispersing into nothing.

「―――それでも」
　俺に謝ることなく死んだのは、悲しかった。
lines.label: s301
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
Nothing comes to mind.
From the very beginning, she had meant to kill me at the cost of her own life.
Did she believe that would serve as some small punishment?
―――Absurd.
Such a thing―――means nothing. Nothing at all.
“―――Even so”
It hurts that she died without ever apologizing to me.

"---Still."
I was sad that she died before she apologized to me.

lines.maoEnglish:

Knowing an apology could never repay what she had done, she refused to offer one even at the end.
That resolve of hers—and the knowledge that I drove her to it—makes me furious.

lines.label: s301

Right to the end.
She mattered so much that even on the threshold of death, my heart still aches for her.

lines.label: s301

I gaze vaguely up at the moon, my thoughts adrift, and before I know it I am falling… asle――――

“Could I…?”
My twitching fingers touch my glasses; in the same motion, I fling something away.
The hard clatter echoes down the corridor beneath the sea.

"No…… way."
I bring my slightly trembling fingers up to my glasses and throw.
Clang.
The dull sound echoes through the hallway.

　ゆらゆらと揺らいでいる。
　何もかも偽りで、近づけば消えてしまう幻。

Everything is fake, an illusion that disappears when you approach it.

We only stare at each other through the haze.

The thought had simply never occurred to me.
“I couldn’t do anything that cruel to you.”

―――She is furious.

「貴方ほど馬鹿な人は、初めてでした」
　先輩は銃剣の切っ先を俺の心臓に当てた。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――I have met a great many people.”
She steps closer.
“But never anyone as foolish as you.”
She sets the point of her gun-blade against my heart.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

She takes a step forward.
"This is the first time I've met someone as stupid as you."
Senpai places the tip of her bayonet right up against my heart.

lines.japanese:
「――――――」
「――――――」
　……どうしてだろう。
　なぜか、引き金が引かれない。
　俺を見つめてくる目は虚ろだ。
　……先輩が時折見せる、感情のない瞳。
それは、この人が冷酷な人というわけじゃなくて。
　単に―――自分自身を騙せないから、結局自分の感情を殺すしかないからじゃないんだろうか。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
“――――――”
Why does she not pull the trigger?
Her eyes remain hollow as they stare into mine.
I have seen that emptiness in her before.
Perhaps it never meant she was cold.
Perhaps she simply―――cannot deceive herself, and so has no choice but to kill what she feels.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:

"------"

…… Those emotionless eyes that Senpai shows me.
That doesn't mean she's a cold-hearted person, but…
Simply---She can't deceive herself, so in the end, I suppose all she could do was just kill her emotions.

　ああ、やっと気づいた。
　この目をする時、先輩はいつも――俺ではなく、自分自身を、騙していたんだっていうコトが。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
At last I understand.
Whenever her eyes looked like this, the person she was deceiving was always――not me, but herself.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Yeah, I finally realized it.
That whenever she showed those eyes, she wasn't fooling me--she was fooling herself.

lines.japanese:
「……殺さないのか、先輩」
「―――忘れていました。
最後に、懺悔を聞いておかないといけません。
わたし、これでも聖職者ですから」
「……そう。
懺悔なんてないけど、一つだけ、聞いていいかな」
「――――はい。
手短にお願いします」
「……うん、すぐ済む。
ただ、どうして先輩は、そんなに泣きそうな顔をしてるのかなって、思って」
「な―――――――」
　びくり、と。
　シエルの体が、震えた気がした。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“Aren’t you going to kill me, Ciel?”
“―――I forgot. I have to hear your final confession first. I am still a member of the clergy, after all.”
“I have nothing to confess. But may I ask one question?”
“――――Yes. Please make it brief.”
“It won’t take long. I was only wondering why you look as if you’re about to cry.”
“Wh―――――――”
A sudden flinch.
Ciel’s body seems to tremble.

I think Ciel's body trembled.

lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――I am not about to cry.”
The face with which she declares it is coldness itself.
Put that way, even I find myself wondering whether I imagined it.
And yet, to me she still――――
“…looks as if she might cry. I don’t know why.”
“That is your imagination. I feel nothing.”

「―――わたしにある感情は、人間として死にたいというものだけです。
それ以外の感情なんて、ない」
　感情のない目をしたまま、彼女はそう言った。
　ひどく、悲しい。
　こんな時に、それが嘘だなんて解ってしまうなんて、皮肉すぎる。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――The only feeling left in me is the desire to die as a human being. Nothing else remains.”
She says it with those empty eyes.
How terribly sad.
What bitter irony that only now, of all times, I can tell she is lying.

lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“…That’s cruel. You’re going to lie to me right to the end?”
“―――――――”
She gives no answer.
Frozen in place, she does not move.

死んだらなにもないじゃないか。
一応経験があるから、それぐらいはわかってる。
……本音を言えば生きていたい。
けど、ただ生きているなんてのは、もうダメなんだ」
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――You are lying too. You do not truly wish to be killed by me here.”
“—Of course I don’t. Death leaves you with nothing. I’ve experienced it once, so I know that much. If I’m honest, I want to live. But just staying alive isn’t enough anymore.”
lines.mao_english:
“―――You are lying too. You do not truly wish to be killed by me here.”

"…… Of course.

…… To tell the truth, I want to live.

……そう、ダメだ。
　もしここでなんとか生き延びても、その先には何もない。
　遠野志貴なんていう人間もいなくなって、この人が経験してしまったような出来事を繰り返す。
　けど、そんな事より。
　このままでいっても、そこには先輩がいない。
　そんな生活には、俺はきっと耐えられない。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
Yes.
It is not enough.
Even if I somehow survive this night, there is nothing beyond it.
Shiki Tohno will disappear, and I will repeat the horrors she once endured.
But more than any of that—she will not be there.
I know I could never bear such a life.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Even if I manage to keep living, there's nothing for me after that.
The person called Tohno Shiki would die and would do things just like this person experienced.

「……今まで、すごく楽しかったんだ、先輩。
　有彦と俺と先輩でバカな話をしている時は、悪くなかった。
ただの休み時間でも、先輩がきてくれるだけで夢みたいに、楽しかった。

もう叶わないけど、俺は―――ずっと、あのままの生活が続いてほしかった」
「まだ解らないんですか。
アレはただの芝居だったって、言ったのに」
「ああ、それでも――――本当に、楽しかった」
　そう口にした瞬間、ひどく心が落ち着いた。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“…I was so happy, Ciel.
When Arihiko and I sat around talking nonsense with you, it wasn’t bad at all. Even an ordinary lunch break felt like a dream if you came to see us.
I think that was my wish. It can never come true now, but I―――wanted that life to go on forever.”
“Do you still not understand? I told you it was only a performance.”
“I know. Even so――――it truly made me happy.”
The instant I say it, a profound calm settles over me.
lines.mao_english:

“Do you still not understand? I told you it was only a performance.”
“I know. Even so――――it truly made me happy.”
The instant I say it, a profound calm settles over me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Senpai, everything was fun up until now.
The times I spent with you and Arihiko weren't bad.
Even during breaks when you came, it was fun, almost like a dream.
…… That's probably what my wish is.
It can't ever be granted, but---I really wanted that kind of life to continue."
"You still don't understand?
I already said it was all fake."
"Yeah, but still----it really was fun."
The instant I say that, my heart calms down.

lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
An illusion forever beyond reach would be fine. So would a mirage that had never existed at all.
No, perhaps precisely because it was an illusion―――the time I spent with her now feels all the more precious.
I cannot be saved in any case.
Then―――if I can remain inside that dream until the end, how――――

lines.maoEnglish:
“How―――――”
She whispers the word foolish.
She shifts the gun-blade slightly.
With a scrape, the blade enters my chest.
Only a little—the depth of a fingernail—but
its point bites into my flesh.
Her gaze is fixed.
All that remains is for her to take one step forward, and it will be over.

It only goes into me slightly, like a fingernail's depth.

It must be harder for her while I am watching.

Hoping to spare her any further pain,
I close my eyes and choose to accept what comes.

lines.japanese:
俺は、昔死にかけて。
　その後に、ただ生きているというコトは、それだけで幸運なコトなんだって気がついた。
　死の見える世界。
　死が視える世界。
　いつだって簡単に、何かの弾みで失われていくモノたち。
　けど、だからこそ――――生きているという事は、それだけで幸運なコトなんだ。
　それを実感できる事。
こうして先輩の体温を感じられる事は、それだけで、幸福すぎる。
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
Long ago, I nearly died.
Afterward I realized that merely being alive was already a stroke of incredible fortune.
A world where death is visible.
A world where I can see death.
Things that can vanish at any time, lost to the smallest accident.
But precisely because of that――――life itself is a blessing.
To feel that truth. To feel Ciel’s warmth against me is almost too much happiness to bear.

lines.japanese:
「―――先輩。
俺、先輩がすごく大切だ」
「…………っ」
「俺はやっぱり死にたくない。
ぎりぎりまで生きて、こうして先輩と一緒にいたい」
　ぎゅっ、と。
　先輩の手が、強く、握られる。
「だから先輩には生きていてほしいんだ。
お願いだから……死ぬことが望みなんて、言わないでくれ」
「……………」
　返答はない。
　とくん、とくん、と。
　先輩の鼓動が、肌を通じて伝わってくるだけで。

「……………だめ、ですよ、そんなの」
　不意に。
　泣きそうな声で、彼女は言った。

「……わたしは、そのために今まで生きていたんです。
　死ねるから。
ロアさえ消してしまえば死ねるから、わたしは死ななくちゃいけないから、ずっと、我慢してこれた。
　お父さんとお母さんを殺したから、みんなを殺してしまったから、こんな体になったから、遠野くんを騙して殺そうとしたから―――わたしは、早く、一秒でも早く、死なないと、いけない」
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――Ciel. You matter so much to me.”
“…!”
“I do not want to die after all. I want to live until the last possible moment and spend that time with you.”
Her hand closes around mine.
She squeezes hard.
“So I want you to live too. Please—do not say that death is what you want.” “…”
She does not answer.
Thump, thump.
All I can feel is Ciel’s heartbeat through our skin.
“—No, you can’t ask that of me.”
Suddenly.
She speaks, her voice close to tears.
“That is what I have lived for.
I endured it all for that reason. I would be allowed to die once Roa was gone—because I had to die.
I killed my mother and father, killed everyone, became this thing, deceived you, and tried to murder you―――so I have to die, as soon as I possibly can.”

“―――But there is no reason I should be allowed to live, either.”
She says it.
Ciel gives a tiny laugh, as if mocking herself.

“—I know. I thought I understood that I had no right. I have done so many terrible things.”

Ciel whispers in a trembling voice.
“I am not allowed to be happy. That is why I never thought about it, never even let myself dream…!
And yet, and yet, why―――”
Thump.
Like a crying child, Ciel pounds a fist against my chest.

lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“T-Tohno, please――――”
“No. I’m not falling for your lies anymore.”
I hold her tighter as she tries to pull away.
“If you want that life to continue, then let it continue. Nothing you described was ever a dream.”
“I—I could never do that.”
“Why not? It truly happened. If you want it back, that life can begin again tomorrow. Please don’t call something so simple a dream.”

“―――I’m sorry. I wasn’t thinking. I’m already beyond saving, yet―――I stood there making grand promises.”
“That isn’t what I mean. I’m asking whether you’re certain you should make a promise like that to someone like me.”
The frailty has vanished from her voice.

lines.maoEnglish:
“—Of course I’m certain. I may be like this now, but for as long as any of me remains, I love you.”
“Then don’t say such irresponsible things. If you intend to make me happy, I need you to remain yourself forever.”
She is right, but what she asks is impossible.
I am not even certain I will still be myself tomorrow.

「遠野くん、一人で立てますか？」
「立てるけど―――先輩、俺を救うってなにか方法でもあるのか……？」
「……確実とは言えませんが、法王庁に戻れば何か手段が見付かるかもしれません。
　その、以前と違ってわたしというサンプルがありましたから、転生体の意識を残したままロアの魂だけを封印する技術らしきものは研究されている筈なんです」
「―――なんだよそれ。
そんな便利な方法があるんなら、どうして―――」

lines.japanese:
「……いいよ先輩。
どのみちこのままじゃ行き止まりなんだ。
少しでもなんとか出来る可能性があるんなら、ローマだろうがイタリアだろうが、どこにだって行くしかないだろ。
　……たとえどんな結果になろうと、先輩に文句はいわないよ」
「―――いえ。
誰にも遠野くんは傷つけさせません。
それだけは信じてください」

lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“—It’s fine. The road I’m on ends here anyway. If there’s even the smallest chance of fixing this, then I have no choice but to go—whether it’s Rome or Italy or anywhere else.
Whatever happens, I won’t blame you.”
“―――No. I will not let anyone hurt you. Believe me on that.”
“—I do. I believe you.”
Though honestly, the fact that I am worrying about travel expenses and passports at a time like this makes me ashamed of how painfully ordinary I am.

lines.japanese:
「けどどうするんだ。
もしかしてこのまま法王庁とやらに行くことになるの？」
「いえ、今夜はわたしが遠野くんの治療を行います。
ロアは吸血種ですから、朝になれば活動も沈静化します。
　……単に法王庁に赴くだけなら簡単なんですけど、遠野くんの問題は裏側のものです。
わたしの時と同じで本来有り得てはいけない事柄ですから、遠野くんは教会の裏側に足を運ばないといけない。
　ですが、そこに遠野くんを直接連れていくには幾つかの許可をとらないとダメなんです。
最低限の洗礼を行うにしても、この街に秘跡を行える聖堂はありません。
　この国でわたしたちよりの洗礼ができる聖堂は一つしかありませんから、まずは一度聖堂まで来てもらわないと」
lines.label: s302
lines.maoEnglish:
“So what happens now? Are we heading straight to this Holy See of yours?”
“No. I will treat you myself tonight; Roa is one of the vampiric species, so his activity should subside by morning.
Simply going to the Holy See would be easy, but your case belongs to the Church’s hidden side. Like mine, it is something that should never have existed, so you will have to enter the Church’s hidden world.
I cannot take you there directly without securing several permissions. Even for the bare minimum—a baptism—there is no cathedral in this city capable of administering the sacrament.
There is only one cathedral in this country that can perform the kind of baptism our side requires, so first I will need you to come there.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"But what are we going to do?
Are we going to the Vatican right now?"
"No, I will treat you for tonight.
Roa is a vampire, so when it becomes morning, he will calm down.
…… It would be simple if it was just a matter of taking you to the Vatican, but your problem is something that should be kept low-profile.
Just like with me, you are something that should not exist, so you have to go to the hidden part of The Church.

Even if we were to minimally purify you, there aren't any places in this city where we could do that.
There is only one place where we can purify you in our way in this country, so I have to take you there first."
